export function NoOutline() {
  return (
    <div>
      <button className="px-2 outline-none" />
      <button className="focus:outline-none" />
      <button className="outline-0 rounded" />
      <button className={cn('outline-hidden', open && 'ring-0')} />
      <input style={{ outline: 'none' }} />
      <input style={{ outlineStyle: 'none', outlineWidth: 0 }} />
    </div>
  );
}
